posts.title: Building a Wall Lamp From Scratch
posts.description: Somehow, I spent 8 months of my free time designing and building a wall lamp from scratch. I didn’t have prior experience in woodworking or LED strips. Read on for how it came to be (and how it turned out).

posts.title: Fancy Network Diagrams with LaTeX
posts.description: Self-hosting pi-hole , Home Assistant , or another service is both fun and useful, but as the home network keeps growing, it becomes increasingly difficult to keep track of what’s running where and how things are connected.

posts.title: Formula 1 Pre-Season Testing 2020
posts.description: Before each Formula 1 season kicks off in Australia, there are several testing days mid-February in Barcelona — a prime opportunity for photographing F1 cars without large crowds in the way. We went on days 1 and 2 of the first week of testing. Having seen F1 cars drive around a circuit in person for the first time in those days, I can confirm that they’re very fast and very loud.
